title: Frontend: Find Missing Number
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Find Missing Number. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values) for distinct integers from 0 through values.length with exactly one absent. Return the missing integer. Sums fit safe Number precision.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
The expected sum is n(n+1)/2; subtract the actual sum to obtain the missing value in linear time and constant extra space.
alternativeApproaches: Reject duplicates/out-of-range values in a validation variant and explain the extra work needed to verify the precondition.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Missing 0; missing n; empty array.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
